title: Lead React Engineer (UI/UX Platform)
description:
Company Overview:
Skyline Interactive is a cutting-edge design-tech firm building the next generation of collaborative whiteboarding tools. Our platform serves over 2 million creative professionals worldwide.

Role Summary:
We are looking for a Lead React Engineer to spearhead our UI architecture. You will be responsible for the performance, scalability, and developer experience of our core React-based platform. This is a highly technical role requiring deep knowledge of the React ecosystem and modern frontend engineering practices.

Key Responsibilities:
- Lead the development of complex, high-performance UI components using React 19.
- Architect global state management solutions and optimize rendering lifecycles.
- Mentor senior engineers and establish frontend coding standards.
- Collaborate with product designers to implement pixel-perfect, accessible (A11y) interfaces.
- Drive the adoption of modern frontend tooling and CI/CD best practices.

Required Skills & Experience:
- 7+ years of professional software development experience, with a focus on web technologies.
- Expert-level proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+) and TypeScript.
- Deep mastery of React and its core principles (Hooks, Context, Suspense).
- Strong understanding of HTML5 and CSS3 (including CSS-in-JS or Tailwind).
- Experience with modern build tools (Vite, Webpack) and testing frameworks (Jest, Vitest).

Preferred Qualifications:
- Knowledge of PostgreSQL for full-stack collaboration.
- Experience with Real-time synchronization (WebSockets).
- Contributions to open-source React libraries.

description: We are looking for a developer who is an expert in the core building blocks of the web and data. You must have a deep understanding of JavaScript and relational database theory (SQL).
